passages.text: The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”

No longer will each man teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest, declares the LORD. For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”
I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples.
Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
You shall not murder.
You shall not commit adultery.

The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.

Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

And He replied: “Go and tell this people, ‘Be ever hearing, but never understanding; be ever seeing, but never perceiving.’ Make the hearts of this people calloused; deafen their ears and close their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn and be healed. ”
Then He said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” At this, Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God.

God also told Moses, “Say to the Israelites, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob—has sent me to you.’ This is My name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered in every generation.
Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

He mocks the mockers, but gives grace to the humble.
